title: Stick Gear
description: This mod adds more uses for sticks, like being able to craft weak tools with sticks.
body: This mod adds Stick Gear to Minecraft, which adds more uses for Sticks, for example, being able to craft tools out of sticks. Which could be useful for players who would like a very VERY early toolset/starting out tools, which could improve the gameplay based on the player who plays it.
